selection.definition: Genuinely blocked source operation: absent source descriptor after an importer refusal, or a source descriptor with a foundation other than closed-source-operation-execution-foundation-r1 and source-cited-non-executable-mutation-foundation-r1, excluding exact currently implemented source bindings.
selection.split_evidence: docs matrix is a projection of current source locks, source descriptors, declaration-disposition ledgers, and CLI surfaces; the underlying split is recorded in .planning/phases/issue-4325-batch1-connectors-repair-r1/TDD-LEDGER.md:379-398.

policy_only_restriction_invariant.rule: destructive_action, delete, reverse_etl, risk, blocked_by_default, confirmation, approval, retained-source hash/bytes, and live certification are operation policy or provenance. They are never a missing-foundation group and never justify omitting a source declaration or discoverable command.
policy_only_restriction_invariant.declaration_first: A row carrying one or more policy-only restrictions must retain its source-cited declaration and discoverable command identity. Its primary group may name only a concrete missing component: action binding, typed input/schema, CLI projection, executor, source citation, or an actual provider-contract limitation.

positive_control.meaning: GitHub delete is implemented and behaviorally tested. Delete is not a missing foundation or a generic safety classification.

contrast.meaning: Stripe account deletion is deferred by the concrete Stripe reference-depth source-importer refusal. Once a descriptor can be produced, any remaining work must be an operation-specific typed action/input/schema/CLI binding—not the fact that the operation deletes an account.

mapping_lane_handoffs.scope: future source declaration and CLI projection only; no connector-definition change is authorized until the required shared foundations merge

current_deferred_declaration.concrete_missing_component: source importer reference-depth handling first; then an endpoint-specific typed action/input/schema and CLI binding

shared_prerequisites.gate: retain Stripe's reference-depth source condition as an operation-level descriptor gap instead of aborting source import
admit a source-cited deferred declaration without promoting it to an executable command
shared_prerequisites.consumer_boundary: the certification PR validates this invariant and does not own connector definitions

writes_action.name: delete_account
writes_action.record_schema: closed object requiring non-empty account and no undeclared properties
writes_action.policy: typed destructive confirmation and reverse-ETL plan/preview/approval/execute; these are declaration restrictions, not the foundation reason

cli_command.availability_before_runtime_admission: partial with the exact source-cited foundation block

planned_connector_declaration_after_prer.ledger_update: bind the source ID to the named action and command identity while retaining deferred status until runtime admission is proven

required_regressions.name: Stripe deferred delete is discoverable
required_regressions.assertion: an isolated pm stripe accounts delete invocation no longer returns unknown command; while availability is partial it returns the exact declared source-cited block before credential or provider I/O

required_regressions.name: Stripe delete source identity is preserved
required_regressions.assertion: source declaration admission and connectorgen validation join stripe.rest.DeleteAccountsAccount to DELETE /v1/accounts/{account}, its official URL, and source location exactly once

required_regressions.name: Future executable promotion stays behavioral
required_regressions.assertion: only after the action/operation preflight contract is complete may availability become implemented; then the isolated no-credential binary stops at the credential boundary rather than unknown command or a metadata refusal

non_actions_now: do not change preserved dirty artifacts

groups.name: Docker Hub unresolved provider reference
groups.classification_rule: All source rows except the four working stream bindings; source import stops before any complete descriptor is emitted.

owner_evidence.detail: reference expansion delegates to sourcePointer and returns a source-reference-resolution error
sourcePointer reports an unresolved provider reference

groups.name: Notion source schema-depth refusal
groups.classification_rule: Source rows whose exact covered-by binding is absent or not implemented; importer depth refusal prevents a complete descriptor.

owner_evidence.detail: response schema expansion refuses a schema beyond the configured maximum reference depth

groups.name: Stripe source reference-depth refusal
groups.classification_rule: All source rows except the eight exact currently implemented bindings; importer depth refusal prevents a complete descriptor.

owner_evidence.detail: reference expansion refuses depth at the configured bound before pointer resolution

groups.name: Retained recursive provider schema
groups.classification_rule: Descriptor records naming cli-recursive-schema-foundation-r1; takes precedence over typed request gaps on the same record.

owner_evidence.detail: the retained recursive-schema foundation is named by the source importer
reference-cycle and reference-depth refusals are explicit

groups.name: OpenAPI 3.0 reference sibling retention
groups.classification_rule: Descriptor records naming cli-openapi30-reference-sibling-foundation-r1; takes precedence over typed request gaps on the same record.

groups.name: Malformed required path parameter

owner_evidence.detail: the importer retains a source gap when a template placeholder has no required path parameter

groups.name: Provider route override cannot be generated safely
groups.classification_rule: Descriptor records naming cli-operation-route-override-foundation-r1; takes precedence over typed request gaps on the same record.

owner_evidence.detail: variable/ambiguous server routing is retained as a route-override gap

groups.name: Provider request encoding lacks a closed runtime contract

groups.name: Provider request media selection is ambiguous

owner_evidence.detail: multiple request media types need one exact generated media contract

groups.name: Provider request schema is not representable as a bounded typed contract
groups.classification_rule: Descriptor records naming cli-request-schema-foundation-r1 after higher-priority groups are considered.

owner_evidence.detail: parameter/body/media schema gaps are retained with their source locations

groups.name: Action/write/transport declaration-only disposition
groups.classification_rule: Zero primary deferred rows: the selection contract treats a source row with only closed-source-operation-execution-foundation-r1 and/or source-cited-non-executable-mutation-foundation-r1 as declarable now, not genuinely blocked.

owner_evidence.detail: a missing action is only counted when no blocking source gap exists; projection does not invent lossy contracts

groups.name: Binary policy
groups.classification_rule: Zero primary deferred rows: binary is a route/response trait in the current data, not an independently named missing foundation. Binary traits remain on every operation record.

owner_evidence.detail: implemented binary commands must name a binary operation with an exact GET contract

groups.name: Sensitive-input policy
groups.classification_rule: Zero primary deferred rows: no selected descriptor declares a sensitive-input foundation as its source gap. Source-backed sensitivity evidence remains on every operation record and is not inferred from HTTP method alone.

owner_evidence.detail: declared secret flags must be env_only and declaration-owned
secret-sensitive operations require non-inline input and typed confirmation
